notes: The plan's nvidia/GR00T-N1.7-3B is the raw cross-embodiment base (no 'type' field, no SO-101 embodiment: its statistics/processor_config cover only DROID/xdof/G1/R1 relative-EEF embodiments), so lerobot 0.6.1's PolicyServer cannot build processors for it from a hub id, and it has no SO-101 action statistics. Every usable SO-101 N1.7 checkpoint is a LeRobot fine-tune (config type 'groot', base_model_path nvidia/GR00T-N1.7-3B); their camera names vary (this one declares front + wrist), so camera_map must match the checkpoint: the default sends our wrist frame as 'wrist' and the left AR0144 overhead half as 'front', and another checkpoint needs --camera-map. action_space: SO-101 N1.7 actions are joint-space (single_arm RELATIVE NON_EEF + gripper ABSOLUTE, or plain absolute) and the server postprocessor decodes them to ABSOLUTE joint targets, so the client gate is absolute_joint (see backends/relative_ee_conversion.py); never apply a relative-EE/IK conversion on top. action_units: degrees only; check a checkpoint's normalizer stats before use (degree mode exceeds +/-100 on some arm joint; range-normalized mode clamps at exactly +/-100; radians stay within about +/-3.2, e.g. alexhegit/so101-simstudio-lab01-pnp-groot-n17 is radians and must not be used). checkpoint: Apache-2.0, library lerobot, inputs observation.state [6] + observation.images.front + observation.images.wrist (3x480x640), action [6], use_relative_actions true (relative_exclude_joints ['gripper']), chunk 32; dataset Jiamo0912/so101-cube-drawer (public, robot_type so_follower, 100 episodes, 38687 frames, state/action names exactly shoulder_pan.pos .. gripper.pos), 40000 steps; stats in degree mode (shoulder_lift down to -104, wrist_flex up to 101.6). Relative-action, so the Colab side must run vla_bridge/groot_n17_server.py instead of the stock server. alternate_checkpoint: absolute joints (runs on the stock server too), wrist + top cameras, dataset geonmin-kim/SO101-large-small-cube-11dataset-ratio6231-0729 (624 episodes, degree mode, wrist_roll down to -168), 95000 steps, but no license is declared on its model card. Server-side needs: lerobot[async,groot]==0.6.1, an HF token that has accepted the gated nvidia/Cosmos-Reason2-2B license (the N1.7 VLM backbone processor), and an L4/A100 (3B model, fp32 params, bf16 autocast).
